Thanks for the report.

The behaviour described here seems to come from Chromium or Node.js rather than Electron's own code, so it probably needs to be fixed upstream first. Linking an upstream bug here, if there is one, helps.

<sub>Automated first-pass triage. It can only add labels and comment; a maintainer makes every decision, including whether this issue stays open.</sub>

triage: kinds=upstream refs=
interpretation: Scorer field names represent proposed actions, not observed GitHub writes.
explanation: The requested preedit rectangle support belongs to the Wayland text-input integration inherited from Chromium and depends on upstream protocol support. This is a feature request, and the retrieved IME reports do not establish the same Wayland protocol problem.
